text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what do I have to do to run away
with a huge lead just like Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Ah, what's that? I want to hear it too!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just running with all my might.
Nothing special at all..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, come on, why not?
Tell me~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (H-How should I answer that...!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Doing slope dashes
on a mountain, or something...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —The mountains?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (...It's so hard to explain it well.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: —Suzuka-senpai! I want to run like you, so could you give me some tips...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A trick to it...?
Hmm, let's see... Well...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (I'd like to hear some tips on how to explain things well, too...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Nobody will ask me questions here, right...?)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Training is coming up soon,
but I'm already mentally exhausted.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I'll look at some pictures of snowy
landscapes to refresh myself a bit.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Fufu, it's quiet, cool, and so comfortable...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Yaaawn... I'm feeling kinda sleepy...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*... *snooze*... *snooze*...

Ever since then, Silence Suzuka
began showing up late to training quite often.
